title: Database Administrator
description:
**Vacancy Name** Database Administrator
  

**Requisition No** VN4318
  

**Time Type** Full Time
  

**Location** Gurgaon Office
  

**Additional Location**
  

**Country** India
  

**Job Description**
**Put your technology skills to work at SHL and help us revolutionize the workplace! SHL, People Science. People Answers.**

**We are looking for a highly qualified Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to direct and optimize mission\-critical database systems assisting our global products and platforms. This role will work closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Platform teams to ensure high availability, performance, security, and reliability of database systems across production and non\-production environments**
**An excellent benefit package is offered in a culture where career development, with ongoing manager guidance, collaboration, flexibility, diversity, and inclusivity are all intrinsic to our culture. There is a huge investment in SHL currently so there’s no better time to become a part of something transformational.**

**What you will be doing:**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


* Install, configure and maintain database systems across production and non\-production environments.
* Administer and optimize databases including **Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, and MongoDB.**
* Monitor database performance, identify bottlenecks, and perform performance tuning and query optimization.
* Design and maintain high availability, replication, clustering, and disaster recovery solutions.
* Oversee database backups, restores, and data recovery strategies to ensure business continuity.
* Collaborate with engineering teams on database schema design, indexing strategies, and query performance improvements
* Implement and maintain database security policies, access controls, and compliance requirements.
* Automate routine database tasks and operational processes using scripting and automation tools.
* Participate in incident feedback, troubleshooting, and root cause evaluation related to database systems
* Hands\-on experience with Linux and/or Windows server environments.
* Strong scripting using PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation.
* Experience with database monitoring, capacity planning, and performance analysis tools.
  

  

  

**What we are looking for from you:**  

**Essential:**
* Exposure to modern databases such as **PostgreSQL, Redis/Aerospike or Elasticsearch.**
* Experience with cloud platforms and directed database services
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).

***Get in touch:***
***Find out how this one\-off opportunity can help you to achieve your career goals by making an application to our knowledgeable and Talent Acquisition team. Choose a new path with SHL.*** ***\# \#.Net .NET***
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

  

**About Us**
* We unlock the possibilities of businesses through the power of people, science and technology.
* We started this industry of people insight more than 40 years ago and continue to lead the market with powerhouse product launches, ground\-breaking science and business transformation.
* When you inspire and transform people’s lives, you will experience the greatest business outcomes possible. SHL’s products insights, experiences, and services can help achieve growth at scale.
  

  

**What SHL can offer you**
Diversity, equity, inclusion and accessibility are key threads in the fabric of SHL’s business and culture (find out more about DEI and accessibility at SHL)


* Employee benefits package that takes care of you and your family.
* Support, coaching, and on\-the\-job development to achieve career success
* A fun and flexible workplace where you’ll be inspired to do your best work (find out more LifeAtSHL)
* The ability to transform workplaces around the world for others.

SHL is an equal opportunity employer. We support and encourage applications from a diverse range of candidates. We can, and do make adjustments to make sure our recruitment process is as inclusive as possible.

title: Rebates Specialist
description:
### **Description**

  

Utilities One Group is a **US\-based company** supporting the telecom, power, water, renewable energy, and data center sectors through high\-quality services and specialized consulting. Our greatest strength is our people, whose expertise, collaboration, and integrity help deliver meaningful results and lasting impact.  

The Rebate \& Incentive Specialist is responsible for researching and monitoring rebate, incentive, and funding programs across federal, state, utility, and local agencies. The role maintains accurate program information, evaluates product and equipment eligibility, supports Sales with applicable incentive opportunities, and coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure rebate requirements and updates are properly managed.  

**Work schedule:** Monday \- Friday from 5:30 PM till 1:30 AM IST.
**Location:** EMAAR Digital Green, Tower B, Golf Course Road Extension, Sector 61, Gurugram, Haryana – 122011\.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Research and monitor rebate, incentive, and funding programs across federal, state, utility, and local agencies.
* Maintain and update the rebate database, ensuring program details, eligibility requirements, deadlines, and documentation remain accurate and current.
* Review equipment and product eligibility for applicable rebate and incentive programs.
* Monitor program updates, funding availability, and policy changes, and communicate relevant information to internal teams.
* Support the Sales team by identifying applicable rebates and incentives for customer opportunities.
* Respond to internal inquiries regarding program eligibility, application requirements, and guidelines.
* Assist in developing and improving standardized processes for rebate research and documentation.
* Communicate with utilities, program administrators, and other external stakeholders as needed.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Energy Management, Environmental Studies, or a related field.
* Previous experience in rebate, incentive, energy efficiency, utility programs, funding programs, or a related field.
* Strong ability to research, interpret, and organize program requirements, eligibility criteria, and documentation.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience maintaining databases or structured program information.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate program requirements clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple programs, deadlines, and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience working with utilities, government agencies, rebate administrators, or similar external stakeholders is preferred.

### **Job Benefits**

  

* Competitive salary package.
* One way travel (Office to Home) Expenses cover.
* Being a part of a multi\-cultural, dynamic work environment.
* Opportunity to work in a US\-based fast\-growing company with significant impact in the industry.

  

### **About Utilities One**


We specialize in delivering innovative solutions and exceptional services to meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations and drive success in every project we undertake.
